notes.title: Strength of the Sword ULTIMATE build 1.0(28)
notes.content:
HELLOOOOOO EVERYONE! WE ARE ALIVE!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25496233/c43dfa620777305b0d2f0719987fbc6094811956.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]THE GAME IS OFFICIALLY RELEASED![/b][/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/419130/Strength_of_the_Sword_ULTIMATE/
(And yes. I DID forgot to announce it, because I am a complete dumbarse.)

I honestly don't even know what else to say.
I should not be in charge of writing announcements...I have no idea what I'm doing...
Wait! I'm an artist! I can just...
[h1]LOOK!!! A PRETTY PICTURE![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25496233/26d18e89c641deb7f2ec3bad3012da88025b52e5.jpg[/img]

[h1]OH! AND A PvP TEASER TRAILER!!![/h1]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MtQqOMs09rk][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25496233/78a66b0d5769c4054c0eb867ffd0f6d43085364e.jpg[/img][/url]

Is it working? Are you distracted from my colossal failure at doing community management? No?
Oh well...I guess I will have to try harder, slowly improve over time and one day I will be good at this. I will be the kind of developer who will take notes on all the bug fixes and polish since our previous announcement and... wait? When was our last announcement?...
...
...
...
2016???!!!
DEAR LORD! BWAHAHAHAHAHAHA
[h1]IT'S NOT JUST ME! OUR ENTIRE TEAM IS TERRIBLE AT THIS!!![/h1]

You know what...
[h1]MORE PICTURES!!![/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1850712965
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1850697973
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1850701824

There!
I feel very comfortable with what I've done here today.
All that is left is for me to see it tomorrow and realize I was having a nervous breakdown ^___^

Cheers everyone!
Lyubo (head of flying-laser-robot-shark research and...I guess PR and Marketing and stuff)



[h1]P.S: Dark Mode is in the game now.[/h1]

notes.title: Strength of the Sword Ultimate Alpha build 0.03
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25496233/d1d66f16fb38dae6c729dc6383191a6d7b5c189b.jpg[/img]


[b]Hey everyone!

We’re still working hard on implementing the awesome feedback that you guys have been giving us over the last few weeks of playing this Alpha build. We want you to be able to continue to enjoy the game, and continue to give us your opinion on how we can continue to improve the game, so we’ve released an update today to improve performance.[/b]

[h1]We have fixed two main issues in today’s update:[/h1][b]
- Fixed matchmaking in PvP
- Fixed some of the desyncs in PvP[/b]

[h1]ICYMI: Strength of the Sword ULTIMATE: We've got Stuff - E3 2016![/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=67hAnyEB340
[b]Keep the good work up guys and thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm for the game![/b]

PS: If you want to play against Lyubo...add him in as a friend in Steam and challenge him directly! (Steam Nickname: Ratrien)

notes.title: Strength of the Sword Ultimate Alpha build 0.02
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25496233/7b2b555feb17c26d6e8aa5e98d68668d77d73077.gif[/img]

Hey everyone!

I’d like to start by thanking everyone for the amazing feedback that we’ve received so far. You’re all playing your parts in making the game as awesome as possible, so good job!

We’ve got a big update for you today with the inclusion of online PvP so it’s time to get competitive! This will really help with the testing and balancing, and should be a pretty awesome time too! Here’s a full list of changes in the update:

[h1]New Features:[/h1][b]
- PvP mode added
- Co-op level now has a Wave Number display
- Sub-Weapons can no longer be used when you have fallen down
- Right Analog Stick (controllers only for now) can now be used to look around
- Co-op Communication wheel now needs to be opened by pressing DOWN on the Right Analog Stick first
- Settings have been added
- The build version now is displayed on main menu
- The remote player’s name is now displayed on each “accept match” screen
-  A mechanism to detect and signal connection problems had been added
- "Connection problem" notification if you have failed to receive a package in the last 5 seconds. (match is disconnected if problem precedes 
- A button for direct feedback after each stage has been added



[/b][h1]Fixes:[/h1][b]
- Crash on start when monitor resolution is bigger than 1080p
-Shoulder Plate screen buttons now display correct input prompts
- Shoulder Plate screen now shows all items correctly locked/unlocked
- Block button can no longer be used to cancel the death animation
- Main menu now displays Section names and prompts for Single Player/PvP/Co-op
- Fixing desync in MP when some of the player machines is running under 20fps
- Take screen shot to steam library
- Missing particle systems when glow post FX is disabled
- Crash when loading/unloading some of the HUD elements
[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25496233/8a238ef6fc5ea6d023559b8b62dc45d875c2f626.gif[/img]

[h1]WE NEED YOU![/h1]

We want to know what you think of Strength of the Sword Ultimate. Stop by the forums to give feedback on anything and everything from combo’s to equipment loadouts. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25496233/8d72d7078675993674749b6ce0a8cd74fb9b97ae.gif[/img]
